readme: Machine-readable pointer/state index for a fresh coding-agent session. This is NOT a replacement for HANDOVER.md or the canonical docs it points to (see HANDOVER.md §16) — it exists so a session can grep/parse exact SHAs and counts instead of re-deriving them from prose. Validate with `node scripts/check-project-state.mjs`. Every value here was verified against the repository, git history or a live tool call during P176 (2026-09-27) or P183 (2026-09-28); a value that could not be verified is `null`, never guessed.
